narrative.overview: The owner explicitly rejected similarity to Forest and approved an original Persian woven-rug world. This supersedes the botanical and earlier dew/glass identities. Confirmed work becomes visible woven craft; task utility and a legible focus timer support the atelier. The same high artistic quality is a durable expectation across the UI, including quiet utility surfaces, rather than only the home illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Woven rows grounded in confirmed completed work.
Wool cream, terracotta and turquoise by day; midnight ink at night.
Persian-first typography and reversible, direct actions.

rules.name: The Confirmed Weaving Rule
rules.body: Never fabricate progress, XP or rewards to decorate a screen.

dos: Do derive woven rows and collection counts from confirmed completed work and retain undo.
Do preserve Persian RTL, Persian digits and the isolated LTR timer.
Do keep task content readable with user text scaling.
donts: Don't restore decorative glass, ambient gradients or title glow.
Don't display unavailable account progress as an invented score.
Don't infer project-specific threads, colors or historical rugs from unavailable completion history.
Don't present the static loom illustration as the measured progress display.
